claims.claim: Constellation completed the Calpine acquisition on January 7, 2026, creating a 55 GW combined generation platform spanning nuclear, natural gas, geothermal and other resources.

factors.name: power-platform scale
factors.basis: larger diversified generation fleet expands ability to serve data-center and industrial load growth

risks.risk: Calpine integration materially increases operational complexity and acquired leverage exposure.

causalEdges.mechanism: larger dispatchable and nuclear fleet can serve round-the-clock load
causalEdges.falsifier: load growth or contracting economics weaken materially

unknowns.unknown: Incremental realized returns from Calpine integration are not established by the transaction-close announcement.

claims.claim: Constellation agreed in March 2026 to sell about 4.4 GW of PJM generation assets to LS Power for $5 billion before closing adjustments as part of DOJ/FERC Calpine remedies.

factors.name: integration execution
factors.basis: required divestiture advances regulatory commitments and monetizes assets, while reducing retained generation capacity

risks.risk: Remaining integration and divestiture obligations can alter expected Calpine economics.

causalEdges.falsifier: required divestitures are delayed or economics deteriorate materially

unknowns.unknown: Final after-adjustment proceeds and full integration synergies remain uncertain.
